title: x7hh.5 leaf: LR-FHSS RX hardware/demodulator path survey
description: Identify an actual LR-FHSS receiving hardware/demodulator/software path for future LICHEN2, distinguishing SX1262/LR1110 TX capability and ordinary narrow-BW LoRa RX/TX from LR-FHSS RX.
acceptance_criteria: At least one concrete RX path identified or absence documented with evidence; distinctions recorded.
